newsitem.title: UK: ELEGANT MAKES AGREED BID FOR ST. JAMES.
newsitem.headline: ELEGANT MAKES AGREED BID FOR ST. JAMES.

text.p: Elegant Hotels Ltd said on Wednesday that it has made an agreed cash offer of 200p per share for St. James Beach Hotels Plc, valuing the company at 46.4 million stg.

"I believe this is an exciting opportunity for the creation of a diversified hotel group with a greater prominence in the Caribbean," said Andrew Parker, chairman and chief executive of Elegant Hotels.
Elegant was formed for the purpose of making the offer and is currently owned by CS Structured Credit Fund Ltd (CSSCF).
The offer represents a premium of 5.3 percent over the closing price of St. James Beach shares on August 12.
St. James Beach was floated in March 1994 and has four hotels in St. James on the west coast of Barbados.
By 0748 GMT, shares in St. James were quoted 7p higher at 197p.
